description: Diagnose why structural relaxation oscillates and does not converge.
incar_bug: EDIFF=1E-3 is far too loose. Forces derived from such imprecise SCF have noise comparable to EDIFFG target (0.01 eV/A). This causes perpetual force oscillation.
key_observation: Force oscillates around 0.019-0.022 eV/A, never below EDIFFG=0.01. SCF converges in only 3 steps (suspiciously few), meaning energy precision is only ~1 meV.
diagnosis_hint: EDIFF=1E-3 makes SCF too loose. Force noise (~2-4 meV/A) is comparable to inter-step force changes. Fix: tighten EDIFF to 1E-5 or 1E-6. Rule: EDIFF should be at least 10x smaller than EDIFFG.
